note: Counted peat/pore-water DOC as soil carbon; if DOC is treated as a separate class this becomes no_evidence. e48 is an ordination component, so effect null. e4 is reversed and its cause is site moisture regime, not water table.

Only shoot water potential was counted as physiological stress. Release effects on WUE (e19) and Amax (e50) were left out as gas-exchange/performance traits. Overstory cutting edges (e1, e4, e29, e40, e48) were left out as harvest intensity, not cutting of competing vegetation. e47 (vegetation control -> etiolation) was left out because the method is not stated.

No cause node is plainly competing vegetation. Suppression-regime edges compare variants or richness (S), not Shannon/evenness. e15/e51 (manual cutting of generic vegetation -> Shannon diversity) were left out as cutting treatments rather than competing vegetation. e47 (perennial grass decline -> evenness) does not identify the grass as a competitor.
Richness-only edges were left out because they are not diversity indices.
Harvest edges (hyp.13580) report modelled weighted usable area / fish habitat, which is not fish population.
No temperature/microclimate cause with an invasive-cover outcome. e54 is reversed (Cirsium -> soil temperature).
Candidates give only species-level, native-only, nonnative-only or bare-ground cover, not total vegetation cover. Native cover (e.g. e9, e28) would vote increase if accepted as total cover.
No fire cause with a fish outcome among the candidates.

Soil nutrient availability and CEC were counted as soil fertility; plant-tissue nutrients were left out. Within-treatment temporal changes for straw (e1, e13, e14, e42) and amendment-vs-fertilizer e40 were left out. Lake sediment and cover-soil/donor-material contrasts are not organic amendments. Biochar N mineralization (e4) was included as organic amendment; without it the vote is still 3 vs 2, so the direction stays mixed.
